attchmntText: Coromandel International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: Coromandel International Limited has issued a notice of postal ballot dated November 6, 2026, seeking shareholder approval for the re-appointment of Mr. Sudarshan Venu, DIN 03601690, as Independent Director. The resolution is placed for approval via remote e-voting through NSDL. The e-voting window opens on November 12, 2026, at 09:00 AM IST and closes on December 11, 2026, at 05:00 PM IST. The proposed term is five consecutive years, from February 3, 2027, to February 2, 2032. M/s R. Sridharan & Associates has been appointed as the Scrutinizer. Voting results are awaited and will be announced by December 15, 2026.

attchmntText: Coromandel International Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Coromandel International Limited has uploaded the investor presentation for the conference call discussing Q2 and H1 FY27 results. The call is scheduled for November 12, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST. The presentation is available on the company website at https://www.coromandel.biz/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Quarterly-update_Q2FY27-1.pdf. This submission complies with Regulation 46(2)(o) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company requests the National Stock Exchange and BSE to take this submission on record. The previous reference letter was dated November 8, 2026. The filing was signed by B. Shanmugasundaram, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Coromandel International Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Coromandel International Limited has announced a conference call to discuss financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The event is organized by Systematix Institutional Equities and scheduled for Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST. Management representatives include Mr. Sankarasubramanian S., MD and CEO, and Mr. Deepak Natarajan, CFO. Audio recordings and transcripts will be available on the company website at www.coromandel.biz.
